card.name: Cross-references to earlier label text
card.fires_on: The word right after a phrase like "see", "as outlined", "described" or "same as that", such as above, for or under. It points back to another place in the label.

modes.label: "above" as back-reference
modes.description: The word "above" closes a pointer to an earlier section or instruction.
modes.example: (see<< above>>) be used to monitor serum calcium,

modes.label: "for" or "under" after outlined/described
modes.description: A preposition follows outlined, described or same as that and names the section or group being referred to.
modes.example: Relapses may be treated as outlined<< for>> initial therapy.

card.writes: It promotes code-like and reference-like tokens such as " above", so the output tilts toward back-reference wording.
card.plain: It fires on the small word in phrases like "as described above" or "as outlined for" that send the reader to another part of the label.
